verdict.rationale: Shortwave's dedicated announcement documents scheduled send: you write a message, set a future send time, and can use natural-language scheduling. The same post documents undo send, which reverts an accidentally sent message back to a draft. Both halves of the story are first-party features. Missing for 10: details on the undo grace-window duration or whether it can be configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature.
